name: Round Arch Freestanding Mirror
description: A tall, gently arched freestanding mirror that softens any welcome table, ceremony backdrop or dessert display. Finished in a warm gold-toned frame, with optional custom frame colours and floral trims.

name: Gold-Rim Vanity Mirror
description: A dainty gold-rim mirror perfect for a kitchen tea gifting table, baby shower gift table or a bachelorette getting-ready corner, with optional monogram detailing.

name: Marquee Light-Up Mirror
description: A softly lit marquee-style mirror that adds a warm glow to evening receptions and photo moments.

name: Full-Length Ornate Mirror
description: An elegant full-length mirror with a hand-finished frame, lovely for bridal portraits or venue styling, with optional custom frame finishes.

name: Tiered Dessert Stand (3-Tier)
description: A graceful three-tier stand for cupcakes, macarons and sweet treats, finished in soft weathered timber, with optional ribbon and floral trims to match your palette.

name: Floral Pedestal Stand (Pair)
description: A pair of tall pedestal stands to frame an aisle, altar or entrance with floral arrangements, with optional finish and height adjustments.

name: Wooden Welcome Sign Stand
description: A rustic A-frame stand built to hold your welcome sign steady, indoors or on the lawn, with optional colour and trim customisation.

name: Cake Table Riser Stand
description: A sturdy single riser that lifts your cake to centre stage, finished in soft cream, with optional colour and floral accent customisation.

name: Giant Jenga Set
description: Oversized wooden blocks for lawn fun between the ceremony and reception, loved by guests of every age, with optional custom painted numbers or names on each block.

name: Giant Connect Four
description: A larger-than-life Connect Four set that keeps guests entertained on the lawn all afternoon, with optional custom disc colours to match your event palette.

name: Rustic Croquet Set
description: A charming timber croquet set, complete with mallets, balls and hoops for a gentle garden game, with optional ribbon accents in your chosen colours.

name: Cornhole Bean Bag Toss Set
description: A pair of cornhole boards with bean bags, a firm favourite for relaxed outdoor celebrations.

name: Personalised Name Sign
description: A hand-lettered timber sign personalised with your names, initials or a chosen date.

name: Custom Neon-Style Sign
description: A soft-glow neon-style sign with your own wording, ideal for a baby shower, bachelorette or reception backdrop.
dimensions: Made to order, up to 1.2m wide

name: Bespoke Welcome Board
description: A watercolour-style welcome board painted with your names, date and a gentle floral border.

name: Customisable Balloon Garland Frame
description: A freestanding frame built to hold a balloon garland in the shape and palette of your choice.
